title: Reflection file: each commuter's End-of-Day Reflection and Habit Update (manuscript Sec. 4.3.7)
description: Written by the LLM (llm_stub.py stands in until then) from llm_inputs/reflection_input_day_N.json, after the day's simulation. $defs/agent is one agent's answer, for one LLM call. llm_tasks.py also checks what a schema cannot: every agent asked about appears once, habit_update keys are the agent's recurring trip_keys, the new weights are for exactly the agent's usable_modes and add up to 1, and no weight changes by more than settings.MAX_WEIGHT_CHANGE. See README.md.

made_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (model, prompt version).

travel_experience.description: The day's Travel Experience entry: only what is likely to change future travel.
